bands.description: Deepest discount / COD postings documented in October 2026: posted discount-dealer prices for a 150-gallon order ran $5.40–$5.82/gal (HeatFleet) and roughly $5.449–$5.99/gal across 150/300/500-gallon tiers (CheapestOil), against a $6.116/gal state average for the week of October 5, 2026. Will-call, pay up front, no service contract.

fair_price_bands.note: Benchmark-relative guides computed from the current SHOPP heating-oil average and documented dispersion ranges. These are documented ranges and computed guides — never live dealer prices.

heating_oil.prior_week_value_basis: Derived: current value minus EIA's published week-ago change. EIA notes prior-week values may be revised in the next release; YCharts republishing the same EIA series showed $6.116/gal for the week of October 5, 2026 before any revision.
heating_oil.source_name: U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) — Weekly Heating Oil and Propane Prices (SHOPP)
heating_oil.year_ago_value_basis: Derived: current value minus EIA's published year-ago change.

program.basis: Residential credit price (keep-full / automatic-delivery preferred), excluding taxes, excluding cash or prompt-pay discounts. One statewide average per fuel; no county-level or dealer-level prices are published.
program.cadence_in_season: Weekly, October through March: collected as of Monday, published Wednesday at 1:00 PM ET
program.cadence_off_season: Monthly, April through September: collected on the second Monday of each month; no monthly averages are published for this period
program.name: State Heating Oil and Propane Program (SHOPP)
program.survey_form: Form EIA-877, Winter Heating Fuels Telephone Survey
